verdict.rationale: Attio documents self-serve signup with no credit card, a free tier for individuals to explore on their own, real-time contact syncing with automatic enrichment to bring in real data, and a Deal object a workspace admin can enable and view as a kanban, so a founder can plausibly assemble a basic pipeline unaided. However, nothing documents a self-serve CSV or spreadsheet import or CRM migration flow, and the homepage migration snippet describes Attio mapping deal history during onboarding rather than founder self-service. There is also no evidence on time-to-value. Missing for 10: documented self-serve data import/migration tooling, evidence of the under-an-hour setup time, hands-on or independent onboarding reports, guided pipeline setup.
